decisions.reason: The client explicitly requires the commission from a referral-free purchase to be allocated by weighted draw, changing the revenue-allocation behavior while leaving the existing commission amount unchanged.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: After 9 buys, why do only 8 tickets exist? Even a referral-free purchase should create 6 tickets and commission, with both allocated by weighted draw.
